Hi Samir — thanks for the RFP and the windows. Appreciate the clarity.

Short version: we can absolutely do a live demo during your preferred windows, but that will fall into late-evening hours for our EU engineering team (CEST). To make that sustainable and high-quality, we propose two options and would love your preference:

Option A — Live demo at your preferred time (recommended):
- We put a rotating on-call demo engineer on the EU team for late slots (one engineer covers three evenings per month).
- Redwood supplies a product manager + infra engineer for the call.
- We run a 40–50 minute walkthrough + 10–20 minute live Q&A.

Option B — Pre-record + Live Q&A (lower overhead):
- We record a focused 25–30 minute walkthrough tailored to your RFP (shared 24 hours in advance).
- Live 30-minute Q&A at an agreeable overlapping time for both teams (shorter attendance burden).

Concrete time proposals that fit your windows and map cleanly to CEST:
- Thu, Aug 27 — 9:30am PDT / 18:30 CEST (live, option A)
- Wed, Aug 26 — 10:00am PDT / 19:00 CEST (live, option A)
- Tue, Aug 25 — recorded walkthrough shared by 09:00am PDT, live Q&A 17:00 PDT / 02:00 CEST (option B — less desirable)

Internal note: daylight savings are in effect for both regions in August (PDT/CEST), so the offsets are PDT = UTC-7 and CEST = UTC+2 (9-hour difference). We'll include timezone labels in the calendar invite to avoid confusion.

I've attached a short proposal that outlines a two-week rotation plan and staffing cost (proposed-shift-rotation.pdf). Priyom and Vivek — can one of you volunteer for the Aug 27 evening coverage?

Samir — if Option A, Aug 27 9:30am PDT / 18:30 CEST works for you, we'll send a calendar invite with both timezones and two engineer attendees. If you prefer Option B, tell us which recorded slot you'd like and we'll prioritize the walkthrough topics.

Thanks,
